page.layout: One printed page: title block centred at the top (letterspaced heading, italic imprint lines), below it a woodcut emblem with the motto around it, then "ANNO" and the year in the old numeral form. Library stamp at lower left is not transcribed.
page.notes: The first line reads "NEOSTADII IN PA-" with the word continued at the margin edge ("PALATINATU"). The woodcut shows a cornucopia held between two hands within an oval, with a Hebrew-letter symbol above and the motto "SERVATA FIDES" and "DITAT" around the border. The year is printed as cIↄ. Iↄ. LXXXV., which reads MDLXXXV. The printed "latinatu" line is in italic, shown as "latinatu, excudebat Matthæus Harnisch." The emblem text around the oval is the printer's motto and was read with some uncertainty. Library stamp omitted.
